INTEGRATED SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
